title: Ancestry search places Sherman in Omaha near Offutt AFB
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ancestry search places Sherman in Omaha near Offutt AFB, about 1993-1994 at Omaha, Nebraska / Offutt Air Force Base, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Omaha, Nebraska / Offutt Air Force Base

tellings.quote: The results showed that Sherman likely in fact lived in Omaha, Nebraska between 1993 and 1994

plain: A former Air Force sergeant, Dan Sherman, says the NSA (the National Security Agency, the US agency that intercepts communications) hired him to communicate with aliens. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a search of ancestry.com, a family-records website, credited to someone named Richard Geldridge, showed that Sherman likely lived in Omaha, Nebraska, in 1993 and 1994, near Offutt Air Force Base, which Michels offers as support for parts of Sherman's story.
